:::{#def-kronecker-product}
#### Kronecker product

The **Kronecker product**
of an $m \times n$ [matrix](linear-algebra.qmd#def-matrix) $\matr{A}$
and a $p \times q$ matrix $\matr{B}$
is the $mp \times nq$ [block matrix](linear-algebra.qmd#def-block-matrix)

$$
\matr{A} \otimes \matr{B}
= \begin{bmatrix}
\matr{A}_{11} \matr{B} & \cdots & \matr{A}_{1n} \matr{B} \\
\vdots & \ddots & \vdots \\
\matr{A}_{m1} \matr{B} & \cdots & \matr{A}_{mn} \matr{B}
\end{bmatrix}.
$$

:::
